result.instructions: Tools for Abstract API, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is jane.smith@example.com a valid email address, and is it disposable?"; "What is the VAT rate in Germany, including reduced rates?"; "Convert 2,500 euros to US dollars at today's rate.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Abstract API data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run abstractapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run abstractapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run abstractapi_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. abstractapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: abstractapi_validate_email
tools.title: Validate email
tools.description: Check one email address: deliverability (format, MX, SMTP), quality score, free/disposable/role/catch-all flags, sender details and known data breaches. Email Reputation API. Spends 1 credit of your Email Reputation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Email Reputation API key.

email.description: The email address to check, e.g. jane@example.com.

tools.name: abstractapi_lookup_phone
tools.title: Look up phone number
tools.description: Validate and enrich one phone number: format, carrier, line type (mobile, landline, VoIP), location, line status, risk and known breaches. Phone Intelligence API. Spends 1 credit of your Phone Intelligence plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Phone Intelligence API key.

phone.description: The phone number, ideally with the international prefix, e.g. +14155550100.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the number, only needed when the number has no international prefix.

tools.name: abstractapi_lookup_ip
tools.title: Look up IP address
tools.description: Geolocation and security intelligence for one IPv4 or IPv6 address: VPN/proxy/Tor/hosting/abuse flags, ASN, company, location, timezone, flag and currency. IP Intelligence API. An explicit ip_address is required (without one Abstract would look up the caller's own address, which here is this server's). Spends 1 credit of your IP Intelligence plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the IP Intelligence API key.

ip_address.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up. Required.

fields.description: Only these top-level sections, e.g. location,security (security, asn, company, domains, location, timezone, flag, currency).

tools.name: abstractapi_enrich_company
tools.title: Enrich company
tools.description: Firmographic data for a company web domain: name, description, logo, address, industry (SIC/NAICS), employee and revenue ranges, contacts, social profiles, technologies. Company Enrichment API. Spends 1 credit of your Company Enrichment plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Company Enrichment API key.

domain.description: The company's domain, e.g. airbnb.com (a pasted URL is reduced to its domain).

fields.description: Only these top-level keys, e.g. company_name,industry,employee_range.

tools.name: abstractapi_validate_iban
tools.title: Validate IBAN
tools.description: Check the structure and check digits of one International Bank Account Number. It does not prove that the account exists. IBAN Validation API. Spends 1 credit of your IBAN Validation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the IBAN Validation API key.

iban.description: The IBAN, with or without spaces.

tools.name: abstractapi_validate_vat
tools.title: Validate VAT number
tools.description: Check whether a VAT number is valid and, if it is, return the registered company name and address. VAT Validation API. Spends 1 credit of your VAT Validation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the VAT Validation API key.

vat_number.description: The VAT number including the two-letter country prefix, e.g. SE556656688001.

tools.name: abstractapi_calculate_vat
tools.title: Calculate VAT
tools.description: Work out the VAT-compliant price for an amount in a country: the amounts without and with VAT, the VAT amount and the rate. Set is_vat_incl to true for the reverse calculation (the amount already contains VAT). VAT Validation API. Spends 1 credit of your VAT Validation plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the VAT Validation API key.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code of the transaction, e.g. DE.

is_vat_incl.description: True if the amount already includes VAT (default false).

vat_category.description: A reduced-rate category from abstractapi_list_vat_rates (default: the standard rate).

tools.name: abstractapi_list_vat_rates
tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: The latest VAT rates of one country: the standard rate and each reduced-rate category with its description. VAT Validation API. Abstract answers this endpoint without checking the key and may not count it as a credit; this tool still needs the VAT API key.

tools.name: abstractapi_get_exchange_rates
tools.title: Get exchange rates
tools.description: Latest foreign-exchange and cryptocurrency rates for a base currency against one or more targets (all supported currencies if none is given). Exchange Rates API. Spends 1 credit of your Exchange Rates plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Exchange Rates API key.

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD.

target.description: Target currencies separated by commas, e.g. EUR,GBP,JPY. Omit for all.

tools.name: abstractapi_convert_currency
tools.title: Convert currency
tools.description: Convert an amount from a base currency to one target currency, at the latest rate or at the rate of a past date. Exchange Rates API. Spends 1 credit of your Exchange Rates plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Exchange Rates API key.

base.description: Currency to convert from, e.g. USD.

target.description: Currency to convert to, e.g. EUR (one currency).

date.description: A past date, yyyy-mm-dd (default: the latest rate).

tools.name: abstractapi_get_historical_rates
tools.title: Get historical exchange rates
tools.description: Exchange rates of a base currency on a past date. Abstract lists this endpoint as closed beta: a key may be refused (HTTP 401/403) until Abstract enables it. Exchange Rates API. Spends 1 credit of your Exchange Rates plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Exchange Rates API key.

target.description: Target currencies separated by commas. Omit for all.

tools.name: abstractapi_get_holidays
tools.title: Get public holidays
tools.description: Public, local and religious holidays of a country for a date, a month or a year. Free Abstract plans require year, month and day together; paid plans default missing values to today. Public Holidays API. Spends 1 credit of your Public Holidays plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Public Holidays API key.

day.description: Day of the month 1-31 (needs month and year).

tools.name: abstractapi_get_current_time
tools.title: Get current time
tools.description: The current local date, time and timezone (name, abbreviation, GMT offset, daylight saving) of a place, coordinates or IP address. Timezone API. Spends 1 credit of your Timezone plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Timezone API key.

location.description: A place name (e.g. Oxford, United Kingdom), latitude,longitude coordinates, or an IP address.

tools.name: abstractapi_convert_time
tools.title: Convert time between locations
tools.description: Convert a date and time from one location to another (places, coordinates or IP addresses). Without base_datetime the current time is converted. Timezone API. Spends 1 credit of your Timezone plan per request (a failed request counts too); needs the Timezone API key.

base_location.description: The location the time belongs to.

target_location.description: The location to convert the time into.

base_datetime.description: The time to convert, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss in the base location (default: now).

prompts.title: Get started with Abstract API
prompts.description: What you can do with Abstract API here, with example requests to try.
